games.name: Wheel Machine Simulator
games.desc:
Get your spin right. Master the machine.

Step into the grease-stained boots of a professional wheel launcher in Wheel Machine Simulator. Forget the open road—this is about raw, mechanical precision. How far can you make it roll?
